dispositions.INV-1: Original8-bit evt_hold=300 captures are invalid (effective44). Selected INV1-recapture originals explicitly record repaired12-bit hold300, native socket/use_core=False and div8 PINNED. No new capture or hardware contact.
dispositions.SUP-1: Retired mc1/mc2 v1 population remains retired as a standing denominator; retained observations are not defective. This fixed43 scope is a bounded new preregistration, not restoration of the retired standing gate.
dispositions.INV-2: fz2c/fz2e discovery observations remain documentary only; no fz2 case enters this43 population.
dispositions.prior_exposures: All prior19 and prior9 discovery source keys excluded from the24. Future mechanisms selected using these24 after scoring must use a separately preregistered disjoint population.

file_identity_policy: Each gzip input permits its single sealed SHA256. Text permits only explicitly listed originalGitLF/exactGitLF-to-CRLF identities; no runtime normalization or arbitrary equivalent JSON. A replay receipt records the exact identity actually read.

preservation_reference.frozen_PR6_files: Prior inventory, preregistration, replay runner/tests and previous outputs are preserved; this inventory does not overwrite them.

prior19_candidate_reference.location_policy: An optional old-baseline-root override only locates these fixedSHA originals. It never replaces identities, indices or the comparison rule.
prior19_candidate_reference.comparison_rule: Candidate4096 raw words versus sealedPR6 original4096 raw words at identical numeric absolute indices; all64 bits except bit50 must agree exactly. No offset/mask tuning.
prior19_candidate_reference.native_status_scope: Preserved PR6 actual-production candidate traces are a nonLOCK behavioral regression reference; they are not a nativeLOCK correctness oracle.
